summary: CourseDetail handles the storage, retrieval, and management of course-related detailed records, supporting workflows for add, update, delete, and copy operations with formatted display conditions and multilingual support.
purpose: To encapsulate detailed course information and provide mechanisms for CRUD operations, retrievals, formatting, and business rules validation, including support for alternate languages and structured display.

workflows.name: Add CourseDetail
steps: If valid, set DB procedure to CourseDetailsAdd
Add parameters: CourseID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder (default -1 for blank), NumberingCodeID

workflows.name: Update CourseDetail
steps: Check if ID is not zero
If valid, set DB procedure to CourseDetailsUpdate
Add parameters: CourseDetailID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder (default -1 for blank), NumberingCodeID

workflows.name: Delete CourseDetail
steps: Check if ID is not zero

workflows.name: Copy CourseDetail
steps: Check if ID is not zero

business_rules: SortOrder uses -1 as a flag for blank values and is displayed as 0 or blank
DescriptionFormatted uses DescriptionAlt if alternate language fields are enabled
HeaderChanged is set true if HeadingID changes between entries
WebPage flag is set true if entry Description matches Resources.WEB_PAGE
validations: If Response is blank, add error message Resources.CourseDetail_ResponseBlank
calculations: Numbering code and indent level are calculated using HSPnet.UI.NumberingCodes.SetNumberingCharacter
Level counts are reset on header change using HSPnet.UI.NumberingCodes.ResetCounts
conditions: If UseAltLanguageFields is enabled, DescriptionFormatted uses DescriptionAlt, else Description
WebPage depends on Description matching a resource constant
system_behavior: All CRUD operations are executed through stored procedures
Content formatting responds to session language settings
Data retrieval uses FillList to reconstruct structured lists
exceptions: Invalid Response triggers error message and prevents operation
content_gaps: Some referenced resources, constants, and utility methods (e.g., Resources.WEB_PAGE, NumberingCodes.SetNumberingCharacter) are not fully defined in the retrieved content.
Business context and UI handling are only implied by field logic and not explicitly detailed.
No explicit field-level constraints or database schema are provided.
